Name: qryServiceCosts_ByFiscalYear
Sql:
SELECT csp.FiscalYear, s.ServiceCode, s.ServiceName, Count(csp.ClientServicePlanID) AS PlanCount, Sum(52*csp.HoursPerWeek) AS TotalHours, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost, Avg(csp.WeeklyCost) AS AvgWeeklyCost, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost/cfy.TotalCost) AS PctCost
FROM tblServices AS s INNER JOIN ((tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn INNER JOIN qryCosts_ByFiscalYear AS cfy ON csn.FiscalYear = cfy.FiscalYear) INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON csn.ClientServiceNeedID = csp.ClientServiceNeedID) ON s.ServiceID = csn.ServiceID
WHERE (((csp.Status)<>"Cancelled"))
GROUP BY csp.FiscalYear, s.ServiceCode, s.ServiceName;
